verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language command interface, such as a chat or copilot that lets users run screenings, manage cases, or change configuration by typing plain-language instructions. The documented AI features are autonomous agents for screening, transaction monitoring and level-1 alert remediation. These, along with llms.txt, Markdown docs and the OpenAPI schema, are adjacent capabilities or developer building blocks rather than natural-language operation of the product.
